item.title: Education Ministry directs school administrators to allow students to wear warm clothing, including non school branded jackets
item.description: This comes in the wake of public outcry following reports that administrators of a primary school in St Catherine confiscated the jackets of children because they were not in accordance with uniform regulations. The children wore the jackets to combat the cold weather brought on by the cold front currently affecting the island.
